# Design

The comparison is pure and lives in server/agents/skill-registry.ts: hashBody trims then sha256s; parseCatalog normalises and caps every field and recomputes every hash; standing decides in a fixed order (not installed, bundled, no mark, edited-and-outdated, edited, outdated, current); listing pairs each entry with the installed record; updateCount counts outdated only; markFor is what gets written on install and read on every comparison. Fetching and the 30-minute TTL cache live in server/index.ts (loadCatalog, installedMarks) behind GET /api/skills/registry and POST /api/skills/registry/:id; the URL is REGISTRY_URL unless WORKMATES_SKILLS_URL overrides it, which is how the API tests serve a local catalog. Disk I/O is server/agents/skills.ts: one markdown file per skill under ~/.workmates/skills, 0o600 in a 0o700 directory, ids slugified so they can never escape the directory, the install mark in frontmatter. The UI is src/components/settings/SkillCatalog.tsx inside SkillsPanel.tsx; it renders state chips and the server's action string and never invents its own wording.
